Idalia was an epithet given to the goddess Demeter, who was widely revered as the goddess of the harvest, agriculture, and fertility. The name Idalla, derived from the Greek word 'Ida' meaning 'work' or 'labour', highlights the importance of hard work and perseverance in life.

The name Idalla can inspire those who bear it to follow God's guidance, strive for excellence, and remain rooted in faith.
